title: Payoff Desk Note: Payoff Shortfall and Funds Posting Allowance on a Re-Filed Extension Request in Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases
content:
**The contract used.** For a further extension request re-filed on a Cedarline Summit loan's Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case, the accepted purchase contract and the issued payoff terms are read from the loan's Payoff and Loan Satisfaction file. Where more than one accepted purchase contract is on the payoff file, the one received most recently is used. Among accepted contracts received on the same day, it is the one recorded later by its recorded date and time.

**Rule.**

- Where the accepted purchase contract's price, less its commission and other seller closing costs, is below the required payoff amount on the issued payoff terms, 21 calendar days are added to the requested length for review of a payoff shortfall.
- Where that net amount covers the required payoff amount, 7 calendar days are added to it for the payoff funds to post and the loan to be satisfied.
- Where there is no accepted contract or no issued terms, nothing is added.

A commission or other seller closing cost not recorded on the contract counts as zero.

| Accepted contract | Issued payoff terms | Net amount compared with required payoff | Days added |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | below | 21 |
| yes | yes | equal or above | 7 |
| no | either | not compared | 0 |
| yes | no | not compared | 0 |

## Both sides (hypothetical)

Price 410,000.00, commission 24,600.00, other costs 5,400.00. The net amount is 380,000.00.

- Required payoff of 380,000.00: the net amount covers it, so 7 days are added.
- Required payoff of 380,000.01: the net amount is below it, so 21 days are added.
